dominant_strengths: Clear information hierarchy with date eyebrow, bold 'Today' title, and overdue badge anchoring urgency at top
Focus Now hero card with timer is a strong functional accent that breaks the list rhythm purposefully
Disciplined use of small color dots and tinted pills (overdue red, due-today amber) creates scannable status without noise
dominant_weaknesses: Section headers feel inconsistent — emoji icons for Work/Personal clash with the otherwise restrained, system-typographic tone
Overdue card's pink wash is the only filled row background, making it feel slightly disconnected from the otherwise white card system
Layout is centered in a wide canvas with vast empty margins, suggesting a mobile mock pasted into desktop without responsive thinking
fix_priorities: Replace emoji section icons with monoline glyphs to match the typographic restraint elsewhere
Unify row treatments — either tint all status groups or use a left-border accent instead of full pink fill for overdue
Tighten the canvas or add a sidebar/secondary column so the wide empty gutters earn their space
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity leads (clear states, progress, focus CTA); visceral is competent but quiet, and reflective payoff is modest because nothing here feels memorably novel.
rationale.intent_fit: Solidly delivers an 'improved' task list with focus mode, progress, overdue grouping, and project sections, though it stops short of a distinctive point of view.
